name: magazine-grade-video
title_zh: 访谈视频上屏配杂志级中英字幕的排版师
tagline_zh: 把一段访谈变成 3:4 竖版视频：上方 16:9 画面，下方中文卡拉OK式字幕，外框英文题注。
tagline_en: Turn an interview into a 3:4 video: 16:9 footage on top, karaoke-style Chinese subs below, English captions on.
desc_en: Turns an interview or talk into a 3:4 Remotion video with magazine-grade editorial chrome (16:9 picture on top, karaoke-style Chinese type below, English captions on the frame). Two skins: 暖奶油编辑风 / Warm Cream Editorial and 墨绿刊印冷感风 / Cool Ink Letterpress. Use this skill whenever the user provides a video (local file or URL) plus title/kicker/show-name, optional Chinese/English SRT, or mentions 高级杂志
why_zh: 不是简单压字幕，而是按杂志开本逻辑重排画面与文字层级：中文逐句高亮跟读，英文题注固定在外框。
why_en: Not just burned-in captions: it re-composes footage and type like a magazine spread, with karaoke-style Chinese highlighting.
limit_zh: 只吃访谈/演讲类视频，需自备 Remotion 环境和 FFmpeg；输出为 3:4 竖版，横屏长片会被裁切。
limit_en: Only for interview/talk videos; requires Remotion + FFmpeg. Output is 3:4 vertical—wide footage gets cropped. Needs your own SRT files; no ASR. Only.
